intro_html: Everything you love about a cheeseburger, deconstructed into a high-protein rice bowl. Each serving brings 47 grams of protein for about $5.11 (at everyday cost) and the batch makes 14. Same juicy, cheesy, tangy flavor, no bun required and no drive-thru markup.
cost_closing_html: About $5.11 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls serves 47 grams of protein at 602 calories, so this burger-in-a-bowl actually earns its keep on your plan.
upsell_html: Cheeseburger night, meal-prepped and budget-friendly. No bun, no regrets, all the flavor. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The special sauce is just ketchup and dijon mustard you already have, so skip any bottled burger sauce.
Store-brand shredded cheddar melts into the beef just as well as the name brand for less money.
A single can of diced tomatoes stands in for fresh and adds that burger-topping tang without the waste.
make_it: Brown 5.4 pounds of 93/7 ground beef with the chopped onion, then drain.
Stir in the beef broth, diced tomatoes, ketchup, dijon, and garlic.
Simmer until the sauce reduces and coats the beef.
Cook the rice separately, then stir it into the skillet or serve it underneath.
Melt the shredded cheddar over the top before portioning into containers.
